_readme: EVERY word and every link on helloboe.com lives in this file.
Edit it in Pages CMS (see EDITING.md) or directly on GitHub. Saving it
triggers a rebuild and the live /staging page updates in a few minutes.
You never need to touch code to change copy or a URL.
Headings that have a coloured italic word are split into three parts:
before     text before the coloured word
highlight  the coloured italic word itself
Leave a part as "" if you do not need it. The colours are set in the
design and are deliberately not editable here.
HOUSE RULES (these are checked automatically on every build):
- No em-dashes. Use a comma, a colon, or a full stop. En-dashes in
- Never use: difficult child, easy child, fix, correct, train, hack,
optimize, maximize, mama, mommy, supermom, journey.

heading.before: You're doing everything right. So why doesn't the advice

body: You've read the books. Tried the tips. Asked the internet at 2am. But the advice was written for a generic child. And yours isn't generic.
Every child is born with a unique temperament: their built in wiring that shapes how they react to change, why certain things overwhelm them, what calms them, and what sets them off.
problem.closer: When you understand their temperament, everything shifts. The meltdowns make sense. The strategies work.

profiles.intro: Every child maps to one of six temperament archetypes, each with its own superpower, its own challenges and its own way of meeting the world.

steps.title: Take the assessment
steps.body: Answer 24 research-backed questions about your child's behavior patterns. It takes about four minutes. No account. No fuss.

steps.title: Discover their profile
steps.body: Get your child's temperament archetype, their superpower, a personal letter to you and a deep dive into how they experience the world.

steps.title: Parent with precision
steps.body: Receive daily insights, strategies and toy recommendations matched to your child's wiring. The more you use HelloBoe, the smarter it gets.

app.intro: HelloBoe gets sharper with every interaction so the advice you get next month is more precise than the advice you get today.

features.body: Strategies matched to their wiring. Travel tips for a Maverick. Social strategies for a Detective. Food approaches for an Empath. It's not one-size-fits-all. It's one-size-fits-them.

No more buying toys your child quietly ignores. The Playshelf recommends toys based on your child's temperament and age; leaning into their natural strengths and gently stretching their challenges. It refreshes as they grow.

They'll change. We'll notice. Every insight updates to match it. Temperament reveals itself over time, so HelloBoe keeps measuring and the guidance moves with your child instead of freezing on the day you started.

difference.body: The same moment read through temperament. Suddenly it isn't a problem to fix. It's a signal you can answer.

chat.question: Why is every afternoon a meltdown?

replies.msg: He's been at full throttle since 6am and his breaks are still being built. By five he can't come down without borrowing your calm.
She's absorbed every mood and sound in this house since morning - by five it isn't new upset, its the whole day landing at once.
All day she's been studying - every new face and sound got logged, and the afternoon is the bill coming due for that much watching.
He never escalates to get noticed, so his signals stay small all day - the afternoon is those small signals finally stacking into one big one.

science.body: HelloBoe is grounded in years of child temperament research, including the most widely validated framework in developmental psychology. We've translated this into something you can actually use during a meltdown at the grocery store.
